===[[North East Region, Ghana|North East Region]]=== [[Image:Districts of the North East Region (2018).png|thumb|right|600px|Districts of the North East Region]] The North East Region of Ghana was created by a referendum in December 2018. It was part of the then [[Northern Region, Ghana|Northern Region]] of Ghana. It contains 6 districts, 2 municipal and 4 ordinary districts.
